newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy end-Feb PSBR 6.5 trln lire vs 25.71 trln.
newsitem.headline: Italy end-Feb PSBR 6.5 trln lire vs 25.71 trln.

text.p: Italy's cumulative public sector borrowing requirement was around 6.5 trillion lire at end- February 1997 compared with around 25.71 trillion for the same period last year, the Treasury Ministry said in a statement.
It said Italy's PSBR in February alone was around 7.7 trillion lire, down roughly 5.5 trillion lire from the same month last year.
The Treasury said the February 1997 data was drawn up in line with new definitions approved by the European accounting office, Eurostat.
Last month, using old methods of calculation, the Treasury said Italy had a provisional state sector surplus of around 2.0 trillion lire in January.
